title: Rejection taxonomy, file version 0
description: The rejection codes of a domain pack: every reason the factory rejects a file, a record or a value, with its level, severity, owner and resolution, and the legacy Loader codes it reproduces.

level.description: How far the rejection reaches: the whole file, one record or pair, or one value.

severity.description: critical: nothing from the file is loaded. error: the record is not loaded. warning: the record is loaded and the value is flagged.

owner.description: Who resolves exceptions with this code.

entity.description: Canonical entity the rejected record was meant for, when there is one.

resolution.description: What the owner does about it.

auto_resolve.description: Exception Triage may apply the resolution without a person (autonomy level L3, with audit).

loader_codes.description: Codes in the Loader Rejections reference that this code reproduces.
